packageRules.description: Angular 22 peers typescript >=6.0 <6.1. TypeScript 7 is the native port and no Angular release accepts it yet.
@angular/build 22 peers vitest ^4. Taking vitest 5 leaves npm unable to resolve the tree at all, so every later lockfile update fails.

minor and patch land as one reviewed-by-CI batch. github-exporter reads the automerge label to tell an update it could merge on its own from one that always needed a person, so renaming the label blanks that half of the SDLC dashboard.
A major reaches a human on its own
